about_the_game:
We’re Gerrit and Julia and we’ve founded a small indie studio! We develop our games together with our community on social media and Twitch. Feel free to stop by!

In When We Arrive, the journey is the goal. Here it’s not about fighting, but about decisions, resources, and teamwork. Together with your friends, you’ll travel through a fantasy world and try to reach your destination safely.

🗺️ Planning is everything

Choose between risky and safe paths. Do you prefer to go through a dangerous dungeon in the hope of finding treasures, or do you take the safer path through the idyllic forest? Maybe it’s worth taking a detour to visit the blacksmith in the nearby village to upgrade your equipment.

🌙 A changing world

With each journey, the world and its dangers change. A canyon may be calm and safe once, but on the next trip, a storm or landslide could turn it into a deadly trap. Keep your eyes open and watch your surroundings so you can spot dangers early and prepare for them!

⚔️ Choose your class

Hunter, Mage, or Warrior: each class changes your journey. Forge epic equipment as a Warrior, cast powerful healing spells for yourself and your group as a Priest, or discover traps and secret paths as a Hunter. Each class comes with unique abilities. Coordinate with your friends so you can reach your goal together!

💎 Find treasures and relics

Discover gold, equipment, and rare relics during your travels. Each relic brings special bonuses for you and your team. But beware, some carry a dark aura that could cost you dearly.

⚙️ Grow stronger with every journey

With each attempt, you’ll earn gold and experience, which allow you to unlock new classes, abilities, and equipment. Think carefully about what to bring next time . A shovel to dig up suspicious hills, or an extra healing potion?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7600K or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6GB) or AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard

short_description: When We Arrive is a co-op travel game set in a fantasy world, where you and your friends embark on a shared journey. Play as a hunter, mage, or warrior, manage your supplies, discover hidden treasures, and make sure you all reach your destination safely.
